must_fix.title: yarn.lock not updated for new @react-stately/flags dependency
must_fix.evidence: `yarn install --immutable --mode=skip-build` -> `➤ YN0028: │ +    "@react-stately/flags": "npm:^3.1.2"` / `The lockfile would have been modified by this install, which is explicitly forbidden.` The @react-aria/overlays workspace entry in yarn.lock (line ~5906) lacks the dependency, unlike the interactions and utils entries.

must_fix.title: Target whose ancestor is slotted is hidden: the slot wrapper gets aria-hidden and its shadow root is not observed
must_fix.evidence: ariaHideOutside.ts:90 and :182 use only `target.assignedSlot`, which is null for a target nested under a slotted light-DOM child. Temporary jest probe (host > container > target in light DOM; host.shadowRoot = wrapper>slot + sibling) printed `wrapper true slot null sibling true container null`, so the flattened-tree ancestor of the target is aria-hidden. A button appended to that shadow root afterwards stayed exposed (`added null`). No test covers this case.

nits: walk(node.shadowRoot) runs as a side effect inside the TreeWalker acceptNode filter; collecting shadow roots and walking them after the traversal would be clearer.
Closed shadow roots can't be handled (node.shadowRoot is null); a comment saying so would help.

report:
I'd hold this PR. Tests, lint and type check all pass, but there are two problems to fix first.

**Checks I ran**
- `yarn jest packages/@react-aria/overlays`: 10 suites and 197 tests passed.
- `yarn eslint packages/@react-aria/overlays`: passed (exit 0).
- `yarn check-types`: passed (exit 0).

**Must fix**

1. **`yarn.lock` wasn't updated after adding a dependency.** `packages/@react-aria/overlays/package.json` now depends on `@react-stately/flags`, but `yarn.lock` was left unchanged. Running `yarn install --immutable --mode=skip-build` fails:
   ```
   ➤ YN0028: │ +    "@react-stately/flags": "npm:^3.1.2"
   ➤ YN0028: │ The lockfile would have been modified by this install, which is explicitly forbidden.
   ```
   The other packages that use the flag, such as `@react-aria/interactions` and `@react-aria/utils`, have it listed in their `yarn.lock` entries.

2. **A target whose ancestor is slotted gets hidden.** The new slot handling only works when the target itself is slotted, because it reads `target.assignedSlot` (`ariaHideOutside.ts:90`, and again for the observed roots at line 182). A light DOM child of the host is what gets assigned to the slot, so a target nested under one has `assignedSlot === null`. Two things go wrong:
   - The shadow-tree element that holds the `<slot>` gets `aria-hidden`. Screen readers read the flattened tree, so that also hides the target, which is what the issue says must not happen.
   - That shadow root is never observed, so content added there later stays exposed.

   I reproduced it with a temporary jest probe, since deleted. The setup was `host > container > target` in the light DOM, and `host.shadowRoot` containing `wrapper > slot` plus a sibling. Output:
   ```
   console.log
     wrapper true slot null sibling true container null
   console.log
     added null
   ```
   `wrapper true` means the element wrapping the slot, which renders the target, was hidden. `added null` means a button appended to the host's shadow root afterwards was not hidden. To fix it, walk up from the target and use the `assignedSlot` of the nearest slotted ancestor, in both places. The test suite only covers a target that is slotted directly, so it needs a case for this too.

**Nits**
- `walk(node.shadowRoot)` runs from inside the TreeWalker's `acceptNode` callback, a side effect in a filter callback. It works, but the walk would be easier to follow if shadow roots were collected and walked after the traversal.
- Content inside closed shadow roots can't be handled, since `node.shadowRoot` is `null` for them. That's expected, but a comment saying so would help.

The probe test was deleted, and `git status` shows the same three modified files as when I started.
